selection_policy: Select complete fixed series for the retained candidate; never combine each class minimum from different runs. Original slow series and separate controls remain visible.
data: Synthetic four-style Eino, DeepAgents, DeepSeek Harness and Codex Span graphs; not a fresh four-SDK or real-model benchmark.

OB.dashboard_contract: Historical seven-field page of 200 with full root input; not the current eight-field inputEvidence contract.
OB.current8_lost_fifth_outcome: Unknown; raw/status/timing were not preserved by the old recorder. Internal-space Error4184 is a candidate, not exact request attribution.

SeekDB.query_windows: 1k exact time window and full5k window on the same physical5k inventory; not two independent physical tiers.
SeekDB.dashboard_contract: Current eight-field page of 200 including full original per-Span inputEvidence.

failed_5k_C5.error: HTTP400/API3012 with downstream HTTP500; Error4012 at the 10,000,000us SQL ceiling in bounded existing logs

SeekDB.higher_pressure: 1k allC5/C10 skipped after failed coreC5 latency gate; 5k allC5/C10 skipped after first hard HTTP/API failure.

method.application: One worker, four threads; application CPU uncapped.
method.C_definition: Closed-loop concurrent HTTP clients, not users, fixed arrival rate or database TPS.
method.P95: Nearest rank with at least20 samples per class.
method.P99: At least100 samples per class; otherwise null.
method.independent_source_gate: Frozen source expectations, exact page IDs/order, complete Session aggregation and complete original input provenance; no expected values inferred from responses.
method.no_cross_engine_ranking: Historical OB7 and current SeekDB8 contracts and physical query scopes differ.

retained_changes.change: Dashboard metrics callers request include_cost=false; explicit cost-aware, detail and legacy requests retain their cost semantics.
retained_changes.purpose: Avoid completeness-driven full-window cost hydration for top-level dashboard metrics.

retained_changes.change: Remove a redundant Agent attribute predicate only after exact Agent scope validation; retain authorization and scope checks.
retained_changes.purpose: Keep supported requests eligible for the read-model path without weakening access control.

retained_changes.change: Use a metadata-only projection for metadata pages rather than hydrating large observation and operation JSON fields.
retained_changes.purpose: Reduce LOB decoding and transfer when the response does not require full bodies.

retained_changes.change: Read bounded facts and explicit previews for selected recent operations, with source-revision checks.
retained_changes.purpose: Avoid reading every full Trace to display a recent-operation page.

retained_changes.change: Read complete source through bounded fragments: 2 MiB response limit and 128 MiB per-Trace limit; publish projections only after generation/revision/context checks and compare-and-swap.
retained_changes.purpose: Handle large multi-Span source safely while rejecting stale or partial projection publication.

retained_changes.change: Automatically add and maintain content_complete_v1 incrementally; use its scalar completeness predicate where supported and retain the equivalent JSON fallback.
retained_changes.purpose: Avoid repeated large-JSON completeness work while preserving content semantics and compatibility.

retained_changes.change: Require a total-Token threshold of at least 100, duration at least 1 ms and counts at least 1, with finite safe upper bounds.
retained_changes.purpose: Reject unhelpful or unsafe broad numeric filters. Token>=100 is a changed predicate, not a same-query speedup over Token>=0.

retained_changes.change: Preserve the existing two emergency controls, raw/capability/readiness fallbacks and authorization-error handling; add no deployment switch.
retained_changes.purpose: Keep an operational escape route without introducing a fleet of experimental flags.

excluded: Experimental full-text index, gram candidate and forced-access-path variants
